title: dolianthus trichanthus
intro: Dolianthus trichanthus, commonly known as Sweet Billy, is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents present in Sweet Billy include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing stress and anxiety. The plant's therapeutic actions are also attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress relief and sleep disorders.
